contribution.position: My position is unchanged. The perf report shows peak_memory of 740MB against a 512MB budget, about 45% over. The QA turn cites 380MB from the same artifact, which does not match what the artifact says. That conflict needs resolving before anyone relies on the 'contained' reading. At 740MB, workers would likely be OOM-killed and their jobs retried. The incident log shows two sev2 incidents last quarter, both retry storms, so this is a failure mode we have already seen. The cost margin and the runbook do not address it. The runbook shortens recovery but does not prevent the incident. The test report (412 passed, 87% coverage) does not show behavior at peak load. Evidence that would change my view: a load test at the production memory limit with no OOM kills, confirmation of retry backoff or caps, or a formally revised memory budget.
